title: Research sprint goal: Finish the gated work: code map, validity windows, session state, peers, coordination
goal: Answer, with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps: which MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code with Copilot, Cursor) load every tool schema into the context at session start and which defer them, and whether a server can mark tools as deferrable; and how the MCP specification lets a server change its tool list at run time (tools/list_changed). Findings go into dated gap notes and one answers entry in kb/public (no new article facts and no source rows), so the coord tools setup choice and its docs can cite them.
